name: Disqus

sources.title: Disqus account signup — social or email registration; 18+ acknowledgment required

requirements: Account creation requires name, email, password (or Google/Facebook/X/Microsoft/Apple social login)
Signup form requires acknowledging you are 18 or older
Signup consent includes broad data-sharing/marketing terms — read before agreeing
No product-directory exists; the launchdesk value is a profile page with a website link plus real commenting participation
preparation: Name, email, password (or decide which social account to use)
Product/company website URL to place in the profile's website field
A handful of relevant communities where genuine comments can be left — profile-only accounts have near-zero value
workflow: Open https://disqus.com/profile/signup/ and register via email or a social provider
Edit the profile at disqus.com/home/settings/profile: avatar, bio, and website URL
Leave a few substantive comments on relevant sites using the account so the profile has real activity
watchFor: Aggressive data-consent language at signup (sharing/selling info for advertising) — a privacy consideration for the account email used
Disqus profile links are believed nofollow; treat this as a citation/entity signal, not link equity
Empty profiles that only exist for a backlink are low-value and may trip spam filters on other sites' comment sections
Comments linking back to your own product get flagged as spam on most moderated Disqus communities
countsAsLive: The public profile at disqus.com/by/<username>/ loads logged-out and displays bio + website link
unknowns: Whether the profile website link is rendered as follow or nofollow (not stated on the signup page)
Whether profile pages are still indexed/rendered publicly for logged-out users (Disqus has changed profile visibility before)
